text:
Jordyn: Heads up — pipeline on main turned red immediately after merge of D3124, smoke stage failing on one shard. anyone around?:eyes:
Sam: oof, pinging @Oncall and @Maya to grab initial eyeballs. link: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/9852
Maya: I'm on it, pulling logs now. which step?
Jordyn: 'smoke-gpu-serve' step, shard-2. quick log snippet: ```ERROR: failed to attach nvlink device: -12
Traceback (most recent call last): AllocationError: shard allocator out of memory```
CI-bot: Build 9852 -> smoke-gpu-serve on shard-2 FAILED (exit 137). Rerun allowed by owner.
Maya: looks like an allocation OOM rather than test flake. can someone kick a rerun while I`m checking recent kernel/gpu-driver changes?
Sam: @Rahul can you try a rerun? quick check to see if it's transient.
Rahul: kicked rerun 9852.1 now. also checking the merge diff for D3124 — it touched runtime memory hints for kv-cache.
Liz: FYI I saw a similar OOM yesterday on canary but it cleared after a warmup change. sharing notes in thread: https://go.redwood/WarmupNote
Oncall: if rerun fails, let's bisect to the last green; tagging infra rotation so we don't miss SLA.
Maya: while rerun runs, I'm grepping the allocator logs for shard churn and nvlink attach failures.
Jordyn: thanks — if rerun passes we still should schedule a follow-up to audit memory caps on the new config.
CI-bot: Rerun 9852.1 started by Rahul.
Rahul: 9852.1 completed — still FAIL. same exit 137 and same nvlink attach error in logs.
Sam: ok not transient. RahuI, can you grab the bisect job? propose bisect window to last green at commit c6f8a1..HEAD.
Rahul: starting bisect job now, allocating a quick-run matrix to narrow down between c6f8a1 and HEAD. will post findings.
Maya: I'm dumping full dmesg + driver logs to the run artifacts and linking in the bisect ticket. ```dmesg: nvlink: failed to initialize on GPU1 status -12```
Liz: adding note — if bisect points to runtime memory hints, we should revert the specific hints change and re-run smoke matrix before merging.
Oncall: assigning incident rotation for triage. DM if you need escalation.
Jordyn: appreciate the fast turnaround. leaving a checklist item in D3124 to keep rollback plan ready. :thumbsup:
